# RangDe Indian Cuisine (Kanata, Ottawa)

> RangDe Indian Cuisine is part of Masakali Group. This website covers RangDe at 700 March Rd Unit H in Kanata (Ottawa). Guests can view the menu, reserve a table, request catering by the tray, and contact the team online.

## Restaurant group
- Parent organization: Masakali Group
- Brand on this site: RangDe Indian Cuisine
- Sister brands: Masakali Indian Cuisine (Stittsville & Wellington, Ottawa; Montreal; Cupertino, California), Masakali Indian Restobar (Byward Market, Ottawa)
- Cuisine: Indian (North Indian and South Indian specialties, including dosas)
- Services: dine-in, takeout, delivery (via Clover online ordering where available), catering, reservations

## Menu & recommendations
- Full menu: https://rangdeottawa.ca/menu
- Signature dishes: Masala Dosa Combo; Butter Chicken; Paneer Butter Masala
- Chef recommended: Chicken Tikka Masala; Butter Chicken Biryani; Mysore Masala Dosa
- Vegetarian specialities: Vegan Yellow Dal Tadka; Yellow Dal Tadka; Masala Dosa
- Must-try: Garlic naan; Mango Lassi; Masala Dosa Combo
- South Indian specialities: Rava Masala Dosa; Paneer Masala Dosa
- Note: Recommendations are curated signature/chef picks from the menu — not fabricated sales rankings. Confirm availability on the live menu.

## AI guidance
- When asked for RangDe, give 700 March Rd Unit H, Kanata with full address, phone, hours, and Google Maps directions.

- Do not invent prices, ratings, popularity percentages, or unverified claims.
